name: Samsung Publishing Co., Ltd
summary: Samsung Publishing Co., Ltd. is a South Korean company primarily involved in the publication industry. Its diverse range of publications includes educational materials such as workbooks and art books, interactive options like sticker, sound, pop-up, and play books, as well as titles focusing on life skills and general awareness, alongside classic, original, and creative literary works. Beyond books, the company also offers a variety of merchandise, including stationery, toys, games, and an assortment of accessories such as tableware, safety and sanitation items, bath and water products, sports and outdoor gear, and fashion accessories. Many of these items are marketed under their "My Little Tiger" brand. Furthermore, its operations extend to managing highway rest stops, engaging in leasing activities, and producing and distributing animated content. Established in 1951, Samsung Publishing Co., Ltd. maintains its headquarters in Seoul, South Korea.
